'''Vladimir G. Kanovei''' (born 1951) is a [[Russian people|Russian]] [[mathematician]] working at the Institute for Information Transmission Problems in [[Moscow]], Russia.  His interests include [[mathematical logic]] and [[foundations of mathematics|foundations]], as well as [[history of mathematics|mathematical history]].
